title: Can individuals help save the planet?
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz (szerinted az egyének is sokat tehetnek) – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Individuals cannot make a real difference in the fight against climate change
candidateIdeas: Millions of small changes in people's behaviour add up to a big effect.
What consumers buy influences what companies produce.
Individuals vote, so they can put pressure on governments.
Setting a personal example influences friends and family and changes social norms.
Many successful environmental movements were started by individuals, often young people.
examinerArguments: A small number of big companies are responsible for most of the world's greenhouse gas emissions.
One person recycling or cycling makes no measurable difference.
Only governments can introduce the laws, taxes and large investments in clean energy that are needed.
Blaming individuals lets the big polluters avoid responsibility.
Many people can't afford eco-friendly options such as electric cars or solar panels.

followUpQuestions: Most emissions come from big companies. Why should I bother recycling?
Eco-friendly products are often expensive. Isn't going green just a choice for rich people?
So what is the most effective thing an ordinary person can do?

usefulPhrases.en: That's only part of the picture.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ez csak az érem egyik oldala.
